legacy_writer_barrier: Released intake.lock persists; new leases atomically exchange it without an absent-file gap. Missing initialized barrier is a manual incident. Never delete it to run old tools. Direct file writes/ACL/authentication are outside the protocol.
manual_gates: Explicit request with reason and two declared distinct identities for recovery/amendment; identities are not authenticated. Incomplete assignment or differing executions remain manual incidents; no automatic reissue.
policy: Append-only; never overwrite original attempts, accepted baseline or blind labels. Unknown legacy locks remain blocked. Amendments are factual records with revalidation, not silent acceptance.
supported_environment: One Windows host, fixed local NTFS, one coordinated store, single-thread CLI. No network/FAT/cross-host/cloned concurrent stores. Process-crash recovery only; power-loss directory durability not guaranteed.
supported_reader: status/read_status and receive.effective_status; baseline accepted/receipt is historical. Exposure history is conservative and never establishes independent gold.
triage: Read-only diagnostic and unsigned drafts. Unknown extra files are listed where inspected, not a complete proof of file provenance. No auto-repair or invented human approvals.
